verdict.rationale: Showing per-number voice, SMS and MMS capability before purchase is a fair question for a business phone platform that provisions numbers, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers getting numbers in general (local, toll-free, Canadian, vanity, and "unlimited calls and texts" on Canadian numbers). Nothing shows a pre-purchase number search that lists voice, SMS or MMS capability for each number.

support.subject: As a founder, each number shows its voice, SMS, and MMS capability before I buy it
